blocks.raw: > The Secure Internet Access (SIA) Reporting API lets you access and analyze reports for security events, acceptable user policy events, and DNS activity totals. You can also view Indicator of Compromise (IOC) data to further analyze blacklisted entries. The API allows you flexible access to the same reporting features as in Akamai Control Center, using your own tools.
